notes.subject: em
notes.rationale: Hebrew השמיעיני has no explicit object; TPI requires ⟨em⟩ (the voice).

notes.subject: to the beloved
notes.rationale: The speaker addresses the woman dwelling in the gardens directly.

notes.subject: השמיעיני
notes.rationale: Imperative summons: 'let me hear (your voice)' draws the addressee in.

translation: Yu, yu save sindaun long ol gaden — ol kampfren i hariap harim tok bilong yu; skrumi ⟨em⟩ long mi, olsem mi ken harim.

tokens.gloss: skrumi ⟨em⟩ long mi, olsem mi ken harim
